title: UPDATE: Nvidia Invests $1B in 5 UK Startups to Scale European AI
summary:
Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang announced in London that the chip designer is allocating more than $1 billion to support five startups in the United Kingdom. The investments target firms including Boltz, Foresight, Hiverge, Prima Mente, and Riverlane, which focus on quantum error correction, biomolecular modeling and infrastructure risk prediction. The funding coincides with Huang's tour of Europe, which included a visit to the Élysée Palace to discuss AI safety with French President Emmanuel Macron.

The UK infusion is part of a wider expansion in which Nvidia will announce an additional $2 billion in European investments next week. This follows $8 billion spent across the region over the last year, including minority stakes in French firms such as Doctolib and Genesis AI. Huang urged European leaders to resolve long-term energy challenges and accelerate the adoption of open-source models to keep pace with U.S. AI development.

selectedTweets.text:
NVIDIA $NVDA PLANS TO ANNOUNCE $2 BILLION IN NEW EUROPEAN INVESTMENTS OVER THE NEXT WEEK

"Europe needs to get in the race."

CEO Jensen Huang said it in Paris on the first day of a tour that also takes him to London and Berlin, per Bloomberg. The new money comes on top of the $8 billion Nvidia has put into Europe over the last year.

He also announced new investments in four French startups:
Doctolib: appointment booking and admin software for doctors
Genesis AI: AI for robots
Pigment: AI-powered business software
Entalpic: AI for chemistry and materials research

Huang also pitched open-source AI models as Europe's way to catch up to the US, saying they "can be customized for languages and for your own sovereignty." Nvidia is a key partner to France's Mistral AI, whose latest model was trained on 4,000 Grace Blackwell chips.

selectedTweets.text:
BREAKING: Jensen has just announced that @nvidia in investing $1bn+ into 5 UK startups:

>> Boltz which is building biomolecular models and AI agents that helps scientists predict molecular structures and interactions

>> Foresight which helps owners of major infrastructure projects predict completion dates, mitigate risks and accelerate time to revenue.

>> Hiverge which is building an AI discovery engine that automatically writes and optimizes algorithms for tasks such as faster AI training and complex logistics planning.

>> Prima Mente which focuses on building biological foundation models to decode complex diseases and identify novel therapeutic targets, starting with Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s and ALS.

>> Riverlane which builds real-time error correction hardware and software that work across all major qubit types, helping quantum computers become reliable enough for practical use.

He announced the news in London this evening.

Jensen Huang le sait : la France est le pays le plus attractif d’Europe pour l’intelligence artificielle, grâce à nos talents, nos infrastructures et nos entreprises qui nous permettent de rester à l’avant-garde.
  
Depuis Choose France, notre coopération avec NVIDIA s’accélère, des startups aux grands acteurs industriels, en passant par les infrastructures de calcul et la recherche.

Avec une nouvelle étape aujourd’hui : NVIDIA investit dans des entreprises françaises et s’engage à soutenir notre initiative franco-allemande pour développer la recherche ouverte en Europe.

Cela a d’autant plus de valeur que nous partageons et portons la même exigence d’une intelligence artificielle ouverte, sûre et au service de notre souveraineté.

Merci cher Jensen pour votre confiance et votre soutien.
